999008199.text: ふわああぁぁ……

よう、ねぼすけ。
今頃お目覚めかい？

localizations.en: Well hey there, sleepyhead. Just waking up?

999008199.text: おはよう。ゴゥとリーベは？

localizations.en: Morning. Where are Gou and Liebe?

999008199.text:
はいおはようさん。
二人はとっくに魔物退治に出発したよ

localizations.en: Good morning to you too. Those two left bright and early to go hunt monsters.

999008199.text:
真面目だなあ。ただ倒すだけじゃ
つまらないだろうに

localizations.en: It's always work with them. Just beating up monsters sounds pretty boring if you ask me.

999008199.text:
物事には遊びが必要ってのは
今のアタシなら分かるけどね

localizations.en: I get that life needs a little fun mixed in—I understand that now, anyway.

999008199.text:
残念ながらあいつらはまだそうじゃないのさ。
さあ、アタシらも行くよ。仙人の実を探しにね

localizations.en: Unfortunately, those two aren't quite there yet. Come on, let's get going too. We've got Sage Fruit to find.

999008199.text: くんくん、この先に仙人の実があるに違いない

localizations.en: *sniff sniff* I can smell some up ahead, no doubt about it.

999008199.text: いつからそんな匂いを嗅ぐ機能が追加されたんだい？

localizations.en: Since when did your nose get that kind of upgrade?

999008199.text: フフッ、今朝からさ

はぁ……相変わらず適当だねえ。
もてなしてもらった分、真剣に探すんだよ

localizations.en: Sigh... you're as ridiculous as ever. After how well they treated us, the least we can do is take this seriously.

999008199.text:
はいはい、イェルカまでゴゥやリーベみたいなこと
言わないでよ。息が詰まっちゃう

localizations.en: Yeah, yeah. Don't go all Gou and Liebe on me too. It's suffocating.

999008199.text:
……お前さんなら昨夜のあのもてなしが
特別だと気付くかと思ったんだけどね

localizations.en: ...I figured someone like you would've noticed how special last night's feast really was.

999008199.text:
へ？　いうほど特別だったかい？
ご馳走といえばご馳走だったけど

localizations.en: Huh? Was it really that special? I mean, it was good food and all...

999008199.text:
そのよく利くようになった鼻で探してごらんよ。
この森、ロクな食い物がないよ

localizations.en: Use that super nose of yours to look around this forest. There's barely any decent food to be found.

999008199.text:
そういえば……こんなに緑が多いのに
食べられる果物も、動物もいないね？

localizations.en: Now that you mention it... with all this greenery, there's no edible fruit or animals around, is there?

999008199.text:
この島に巣食った魔物が全部食っちまうんだよ。
島の人らは普段魚くらいしか食えてないはずだ

localizations.en: The monster infesting this island devours everything. The islanders probably survive on nothing but fish most days.

999008199.text:
……えぇー。僕、そんな貧しい村とは
露知らず、昨夜食べまくっちゃったんだけど

localizations.en: ...Oh no. I had no idea the village was that poor, and I just gorged myself last night.

999008199.text:
だから言ったじゃないか。
あんまりがっつくんじゃないよって

localizations.en: That's what I was trying to tell you. Don't get too carried away.

999008199.text:
あれそういう意味だったの？
言ってくんなきゃ分かんないって！

localizations.en: That's what you meant?! How was I supposed to know if you didn't spell it out for me?

999008199.text:
むしろイェルカがよく分かったね？
あの宴がそこまで豪勢だったなんて

localizations.en: Actually, how did you even figure it out? That the feast was such a big deal, I mean.

999008199.text:
種明かしすると、昔似たようなことされたんだよ。
世話になった村の村長にね

localizations.en: I'll let you in on a secret—I've been through something similar before. With a village chief who took care of me.

999008199.text:
へぇ……イェルカが思い出話するなんて
珍しいかも

localizations.en: Huh... it's pretty rare to hear you reminiscing about the past.

999008199.text:
過去はあまり振り返らないタチだからね。
でも、あの頃のことはよーく覚えているよ

localizations.en: I'm not one to dwell on what's behind me. But I remember those days crystal clear.

999008199.text:
あれはまだ、アタシが「サン」というもらった名前を
疑問にも思わず使っていたころだった……

localizations.en: That was back when I still went by the name San without ever questioning where it came from...
